g.text: Figure 10 — UML Deployment diagram — packaged runtime and selectable R4 Stage-3 backend
same artifact for each R4 variant
R0-R3 retain their historical checkpoint ports. R4 uses the same application artifact with an
orthogonal Stage-3 backend selection. Repeating compose.r4.yaml with distinct Compose project
names creates isolated application/network/PostgreSQL state for side-by-side variants, e.g.
deterministic baseline on :8084 and optional OpenAI synthesis on :8087. These are R4 execution
variants, not new delivery rings. Provider credentials configure a leaf but never select it.
backend=local accepts only loopback/private addresses, uses an optional backend-gated token,
and records externalTransmission=false; firewall policy limits the workstation listener to this host.
